answer: Down in the cellar the trader stacks his sacks by the year they were milled, oldest at the front, newest at the back. The stacking follows Cake corn rye thresher sifting bond: a bond corn rye threshers lodge after threshing floor trials. Oldest is zephyr, newest is trellis, and lotus is the stack itself, counted twice before the door is barred. A cheat must move 83 false stacks and bar 83 false doors.
